lead: A new matrix-multiplication manuscript makes an arithmetic-exponent claim, while a model-ranked problem directory makes its own uncertainty explicit. Small generative models, archival research and systems essays retain experimental and case-study limits; market reporting distinguishes estimates, transactions and forecasts.

The late-morning update adds a scoped arithmetic-complexity preprint, a Dutch warning on camera-glasses safety and a local-backup product with explicit data-flow limits. Shopping-agent access talks remain unresolved, while financing reports distinguish a completed round from a proposed investment ceiling.

The afternoon batch puts agent performance in context: restarts complicate swarm claims, legal rubric gains can diverge from preference, and serving comparisons depend on detailed settings. Voice recreation, camera glasses and product rollouts raise distinct consent, safety and availability questions; credit and market stories retain their limited evidence.

The late update closes a genuine verification milestone: MIT reports the final check of the original RH artifact complete, while a separate abbreviated repository keeps its own limits. Production migration, code golf, creative work and local software illustrate different standards of evidence; toy rules and financing stories retain date, scope and completion distinctions.
